name: DevBox
postCreateCommand: mkdir -p ~/.config ~/.local/share && ([ -f /tmp/host-sync/.gitconfig ] && cp /tmp/host-sync/.gitconfig ~/.gitconfig || true) && ([ -d /tmp/host-sync/gh ] && cp -rf /tmp/host-sync/gh ~/.config/ || true) && ([ -d /tmp/host-sync/opencode ] && cp -rf /tmp/host-sync/opencode ~/.config/ || true) && ([ -d /tmp/host-sync/opencode-share ] && cp -rf /tmp/host-sync/opencode-share ~/.local/share/opencode || true) && echo '[DevBox] All host configs copied successfully!'
